findings.claim: Removing the Str8 case changes the encoding of every 32–255-byte string from a two-byte Str8 header to a three-byte Str16 header. Besides inflating payloads, this breaks the established byte-level output and callers that size a destination for the previous header, even though Str8 remains the valid compact encoding for these lengths.

receipt_plan.detail: Run Receipts.GeneratedTests.StringHeaderEncodingReceiptTests.StringsUpTo255BytesUseStr8Header with lengths 32 and 255. Base emits MessagePackCode.Str8 followed by a one-byte length and passes; head emits MessagePackCode.Str16 and fails the header and serialized-length assertions.
